purpose: Read-only projection of original Luther 1912 source refs onto EXISTING FaithPath app chapter/verse coordinates. Do not rewrite Airtable records.
default_rule: Same book, chapter and verse unless one of the explicit rules applies.

rules.reason: App stored source Joel 3,1–5 as chapter 2, verses 28–32, with [3:x] prefixes in Luther text.
App stored source Joel 4,1–21 as chapter 3, verses 1–21, with [4:x] prefixes.
App stored source Mal 3,19–24 as chapter 4, verses 1–6, with [3:x] prefixes.

checks: Reject references crossing mapped and unmapped ranges unless split and verified
For each source ref preserve the original text and show mapped app coordinates separately

Validate Bible text and chapter labels in BOTH offline translations before final integration
